staticText: Birth Options Question Builder for /tools/csection-vs-natural/. Use neutral terms vaginal birth and caesarean birth, not natural versus surgical. It prepares balanced questions for a qualified maternity discussion and must never score, rank or recommend a mode of birth; infer clinical suitability; present generic national rates, prices, recovery times or risk percentages as an individual's outcome; claim one mode is universally safer; or imply that requesting, needing or changing to caesarean birth is failure. Cost and coverage questions must remain separate from clinical suitability and must never rank or recommend a mode. Do not give VBAC or repeat-caesarean advice without individualized review of prior surgery, current pregnancy, preferences and facility capability. Do not delay urgent maternity care. The route does not collect health history or quote amounts; selections must not be saved, put in URLs, sent to analytics, uploaded, synced or gated by an account. Exports are local and user initiated.
